title: shmap-rs 2.0.0: a Rust port of the shmap long-read mapper
description:
A Rust port of shmap, a sketch-based long-read mapper. The original mapper is the only mapping algorithm. This release retires the experimental adaptive placement path (--adaptive, --adaptive-dense) after it failed truth-based accuracy qualification, keeps compact and persistent indexes, batched dispatch and parallel query parsing, and reorganizes the documentation. Default-mode output is unchanged.

The retired path's measurements and the qualification study are preserved as archives. Reaching Winnowmap-level accuracy remains an open target.
